record.description: Zendesk is a leading customer experience software company founded in 2007, revolutionizing how businesses engage with customers online. With its headquarters in California and roots in Copenhagen, Zendesk provides a suite of products that facilitate communication across various channels, including chat, email, social media, and more, serving over 100,000 brands and connecting them with hundreds of millions of customers globally. The company emphasizes quality service and support through user-friendly tools designed to enhance customer interactions.
